What it does

Every tool you need.
Nothing you don't.

Built by a working appraiser for working appraisers. Every feature maps to a real step in your workflow.

PDF Data Extraction

Upload your engagement letter, tax record, and purchase contract. Red Zone reads them and auto-populates every field — address, APN, sale price, seller names, concessions, and more.

Market Analysis

Drop in your HAR or MLS export CSV. Red Zone builds 12-month supply/demand trends, median price charts, absorption rates, and UAD-compliant market condition commentary automatically.

MISMO XML Export

One-click export of a fully structured UAD 3.6 MISMO XML file, including all comparables, market data, charts, and commentary — imports directly into TOTAL and compatible software.

Comparable Management

Load comps from your MLS CSV export. View, edit, and adjust up to six sales comparables and six rental comps — all adjustments flow directly into your MISMO export.

Auto-Populate Your Work File in TOTAL

Extracted data flows directly into your TOTAL work file — no copy-paste, no re-keying. Every field lands exactly where it belongs so you can move straight to analysis.

Commentary Generator

Upload your MLS sales grid PDF. Red Zone extracts the comp data and writes fully formatted UAD 3.6 reconciliation and market value commentary — ready to paste into TOTAL.

Nationwide Deed & Sales History

Access a nationwide database of county deed records and sales history — look up prior transfers, ownership history, and recorded sales and transfers for any property without leaving Red Zone.

How it works

From order to export
in minutes.

Three steps from raw files to a complete, compliant MISMO XML package.

01

Upload Your Files

Drop in your engagement letter, tax record, purchase contract, and MLS CSV. Red Zone auto-identifies each file type and routes it to the right tool.

02

Extract & Verify

AI reads your PDFs and populates the appraisal form. Review the extracted fields in the built-in data viewer — edit anything that needs a tweak.

03

Export to TOTAL

Download your MISMO XML package — report data, charts, and commentary — and import directly into TOTAL by à la mode. Done.

FAQ

Common questions.

Anything else — reach out at support@redzone.app

Yes. Red Zone exports a MISMO XML file that imports directly into TOTAL. Your comparables, market data, chart images, and commentary all transfer in one step.
Yes. The commentary generator uses UAD 3.6 URAR language requirements as guardrails. Opening sentences, methodology statements, and reconciliation language all follow current FNMA/FHLMC requirements.
Red Zone auto-detects HAR, NTREIS, SABOR, ACTRIS, and most standard MLS CSV export formats. If your MLS export isn't recognized, contact support and we'll add it.
Red Zone is a browser-based application. Your files are processed locally in your browser and sent to AI services only for data extraction — never stored on our servers. No appraisal data is retained after your session ends.
Yes. Red Zone accelerates your data entry and commentary workflow but does not replace your appraisal software. It is designed to work alongside TOTAL, a la mode, and similar platforms — not replace them.
Red Zone's commentary generator reviews, analyzes, and summarizes the adjustments and analysis already completed by the appraiser — it reads your grid data and turns your work into formatted, UAD-compliant language. It generates draft commentary as a starting point, not a final product. The appraiser remains responsible for reviewing, editing, and certifying all commentary to ensure it accurately reflects their independent analysis and complies with USPAP, client, and intended use requirements. Red Zone is a productivity tool — it does not replace appraiser judgment.
Yes. No contracts, no cancellation fees. Cancel your subscription any time from your account dashboard and you'll retain access through the end of your billing period.
